ratings.concept: Root pressure: ions pumped into the root xylem draw water in behind them

ratings.note: Damaged as printed. The stem asks why root pressure is ACIDIC, but the source's own solution reads "As various ions from the soil are actively transported into the vascular tissues of the roots, water follows and increases the pressure inside the xylem i.e., root pressure (positive pressure)" - an answer to how root pressure DEVELOPS, not to why it is acidic. Our record reproduces the booklet exactly, so the corruption is in the source, not in extraction. Tags cover only what is certain from the layout and the printed solution; traps left empty under rulebook rule 5.

Solution structure was set by one rule applied across the group: where the stem's criterion has to be tested against every option (q047 "wrong statement", q048 "not found") the label is several_independent_checks, and where one stored fact names the answer outright (q049, q051) it is single_step. q046 does not belong with the rest as it stands: its stem is corrupted in the source and it is the only member carrying source_damage_artifact and an empty trap list. q050 is the only member with a verdict on its key, and the only one given application rather than recall, because no single stored fact decides it - which is also why the source's key and its own solution disagree. q047 and q048 carry true_statement_trap on every wrong option because a negated task gives all three the same device; q049 and q051 carry distinct devices per option and are reasoned individually.
